name: instruction-v1
description: R2-08 fixed general expository/instruction-following workload (frozen for routing drift analysis).

dev.prompt: Write a clear, structured guide for a junior engineer on how to investigate a sudden increase in latency in a web service. Cover: (1) how to confirm the symptom and define the time window, (2) which metrics and logs to check first and why, (3) how to distinguish client-side, network, application, and database causes, (4) how to form and test hypotheses safely in production, and (5) what information to record for a post-incident review. Use headings and practical steps.
